reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: This app shouldn’t be available for download any longer, as far as I’m concerned. The BBB urges people to avoid them. Money earned isn’t allowed to be claimed for weeks, then when it is, users are placed into an indefinite “pending” status. They sit there for months. When support is contacted, some reps promise to push the money through, but rarely do it. Some are simply being logged out by the reps and unable to get back in. Most reps “refund the money” back to the app account balances, instead of paying it out, which is useless since it’s unusable and ensures the user has to get back into the “pending claim” queue yet again. Today a rep confirmed with mr that they CANNOT PAY PEOPLE at this time, and that it’s a COMPANY DECISION they can’t discuss further. Meanwhile they’re still operating business as usual, allowing people to sign up and waste time. For me, it’s not about my missing funds - I only use these apps for fun - but about ethics and legalities. They’re intentionally defrauding thousands and thousands of people, leading to a scam on a much larger scale, since they know they can’t pay out. Unlink your banking details asap if you added them. Check out their BBB ratings. Then switch apps, or waste your time.

reviews.title: Fraudulent company - use Scrambly instead
reviews.text:
After randomly pausing cash withdrawals for three months for everybody, and telling us to be patient, you “opened” withdrawals on your scheduled resume date… only to not pay people their money for all kinds of excuses, with my case being “unusual activity” on my account. Here is their [probable] automated response after I requested attention:

“Upon review, we’ve identified activity that violates our terms and conditions. Due to this your account has been disabled. To keep our community safe and secure for everyone, we have finalized our decision over your account and inquiry. We understand this might be disappointing, but it’s important to maintain a fair and secure environment for all our users. We appreciate your understanding.”

Never used VPNs, never used bots, never cheated at the games and offers, yet they couldn’t say what the supposed offense was. You had your chances to make things right, and you failed miserably. You are now being reported for scam activity to Apple, and a request for app removal is underway so that no one else will be tricked into wasting their time over empty promises of cash payouts. Furthermore, this matter will have to be escalated to the proper authorities as this issue gets settled. My decision is final and irreversible. Benjamin, if you are reading this, thank you for your attention to this matter

reviews.title: Do not use
reviews.text:
I have been using this app for several months. It is legit, or was. I have probably collected over $100. They recently changed the policy about collecting rewards. You have to wait until they get paid before you can get paid. I have accumulated over $80 that the app says is available after waiting several weeks to withdraw. For a few days now, it has been saying “we are busy because a large amount of people are making withdrawals. Try later.” When I try to get my money. Today, I had some rewards expire because I didn’t collect them in time. I reached out to customer support and they only said to be patient with no explanation or offer to give me my expired rewards. I will delete this app after I attempt to get the rest of my payment and use something else. I used a different before that I like much better.
UPDATE: I have reached out to customer service again after a few more days. They just aren’t responding. I have looked online and found many, many people sitting on funds that are also not able to withdraw. Benjamin is also charging .99 per withdrawal now with restrictions that you can only withdraw $25-$50 per withdrawal.

reviews.title: Used to be great, now very disappointed
reviews.text: I used to love this app but like many others I am very disappointed and frustrated with the recent updates. I was told in October I couldn’t redeem until December 3rd. Of course as soon as that day came I tried to cash out but no matter when I try it always says that there’s too much activity and to come back later. I’ve been trying multiple times a day and it’s now Dec 8th. I have $130 in there that it would really be helpful to use. Honestly I hardly even mind the daily $50 cashout limit or PayPal/Venmo being the only options as I use both (although I do wish you’d bring gift cards back) I just want to be able to access the money I earned. As soon as I’m able to cash out I’m taking all the money from my account and deleting the app. I would really appreciate if that’s soon and if someone can ACTUALLY help. (For reference I did email support and they were just like “We understand this is frustrating, keep submitting your request throughout the day”). That was useless because it’s exactly what I’ve been doing. Reading the reviews here hundreds of people are having this problem and no one is doing anything about it.
